## 7.3 Helpers

```{r helpers}
lin_dir <- function(nm) {
  d <- file.path(path$results_pseudotime, nm)
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  d
}

cached <- function(file, expr) {
  if (file.exists(file) && !overwrite_cache) return(readRDS(file))
  res <- expr
  saveRDS(res, file)
  res
}

safe <- function(expr, what) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) {
    message("  ", what, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
  })
}

show_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, n = 20) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) { cat("_no results_\n\n"); return(invisible()) }
  cat(knitr::kable(head(as.data.frame(df), n), digits = 3, caption = caption,
                   format = "markdown"), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n")
}

get_layer <- function(so, layer) {
  if (packageVersion("SeuratObject") >= "5.0.0") {
    LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = layer)
  } else {
    GetAssayData(so, assay = "RNA", slot = layer)
  }
}

prep_object <- function(so, label_col) {
  so <- add_severity(so, quiet = TRUE)
  so$sev_grp <- sev_group3(so$severity)
  needed  <- unique(c(label_col, group_var, donor_var, batch_var))
  missing <- setdiff(needed, colnames(so@meta.data))
  if (length(missing) > 0)
    stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
         "\nAvailable: ", paste(colnames(so@meta.data), collapse = ", "))
  DefaultAssay(so) <- "RNA"
  if (inherits(so[["RNA"]], "Assay5")) so[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(so[["RNA"]])
  md <- so@meta.data
  so$label <- as.character(md[[label_col]])
  so$group <- relevel(factor(md[[group_var]]), ref = ref_level)
  so$donor <- factor(md[[donor_var]])
  so$batch <- factor(md[[batch_var]])
  if (any(tapply(so$group, so$donor, function(x) length(unique(x))) > 1))
    stop("Some donors map to more than one group.")
  so
}

in_lineage <- function(labels, cfg) {
  if (!is.null(cfg$levels)) return(labels %in% cfg$levels)
  hit <- grepl(cfg$include, labels, ignore.case = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(cfg$exclude)) hit <- hit & !grepl(cfg$exclude, labels, ignore.case = TRUE)
  hit
}

marker_score <- function(so, genes) {
  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(so))
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(so)))
  m <- as.matrix(get_layer(so, "data")[genes, , drop = FALSE])
  m <- t(scale(t(m)))
  m[is.nan(m)] <- 0
  colMeans(m)
}

cap_per_donor <- function(so, n) {
  if (is.null(n)) return(so)
  keep <- so@meta.data %>%
    mutate(cell = colnames(so)) %>%
    group_by(donor) %>%
    slice_sample(n = n) %>%
    pull(cell)
  subset(so, cells = keep)
}

embed_lineage <- function(so) {
  if (!recompute_embedding) {
    so   <- FindVariableFeatures(NormalizeData(so, verbose = FALSE), nfeatures = n_hvg, verbose = FALSE)
    miss <- setdiff(c(reduction_reuse, umap_reuse), Reductions(so))
    if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Reductions not found: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
    return(list(so = so, red_traj = reduction_reuse, red_umap = umap_reuse))
  }
  so <- lineage_embed(so, batch_var = "batch", dims = seq_len(n_dims), n_pcs = n_pcs, n_hvg = n_hvg,
                      neighbors = FALSE, umap_name = "umap")
  list(so = so, red_traj = if ("harmony" %in% Reductions(so)) "harmony" else "pca", red_umap = "umap")
}

curve_df <- function(sce, dimred = "UMAP") {
  tryCatch({
    crvs <- slingCurves(embedCurves(sce, dimred))
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(crvs), function(i) {
      s <- crvs[[i]]$s[crvs[[i]]$ord, , drop = FALSE]
      data.frame(x = s[, 1], y = s[, 2], lineage = paste0("Lineage", i))
    }))
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

pseudobulk <- function(counts, groups) {
  groups <- factor(groups)
  mm <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + groups)
  colnames(mm) <- levels(groups)
  as.matrix(counts %*% mm)
}

donor_test <- function(df, value) {
  df <- droplevels(df)
  if (nlevels(df$group) < 2) return(data.frame(test = NA, p_value = NA))
  f <- as.formula(paste(value, "~ group"))
  if (nlevels(df$group) == 2) {
    data.frame(test = "Wilcoxon (donor level)",
               p_value = suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(f, data = df)$p.value))
  } else {
    data.frame(test = "Kruskal-Wallis (donor level)",
               p_value = kruskal.test(f, data = df)$p.value)
  }
}

label_palette <- function(labs) {
  labs  <- unique(as.character(labs))
  cd4   <- labs[grepl("^CD4|Treg|Tfh", labs)]
  cd8   <- setdiff(labs[grepl("^CD8", labs)], cd4)
  other <- setdiff(labs, c(cd4, cd8))
  pal <- c(setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#FCAE91", "#99000D"))(length(cd4)), cd4),
           setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#9ECAE1", "#08306B"))(length(cd8)), cd8))
  if (length(other) > 0) pal <- c(pal, setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(other)), other))
  pal
}

theme_umap <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

```{r assignment}
assign_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(csf_objs), function(src) {
  so   <- csf_objs[[src]]
  labs <- sort(unique(so$label))
  lin  <- vapply(labs, function(l) {
    hits <- names(lineages)[vapply(lineages, function(cfg)

  cnt <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(so$label, so$group))[labs, , drop = FALSE]

             check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL)
}))
```

## 7.5 Trajectories

```{r build-trajectory-fn}
build_trajectory <- function(lin_name, cfg) {
  so <- csf_objs[[cfg$source]]
  so <- subset(so, cells = colnames(so)[in_lineage(so$label, cfg)])
  message(lin_name, ": ", ncol(so), " cells")
  if (ncol(so) < min_cells_lineage) { message("  too few cells, skipped"); return(NULL) }

  n_donor_grp <- tapply(so$donor, so$group, function(x) length(unique(x)))
  if (any(is.na(n_donor_grp) | n_donor_grp < 2)) {
    message("  fewer than 2 donors in a group, skipped"); return(NULL)
  }

  so <- cap_per_donor(so, max_cells_donor)
  tab   <- table(so$label)
  small <- names(tab)[tab < min_cells_label]
  if (length(small) > 0) {
    message("  dropping small labels: ", paste(small, collapse = ", "))
    so <- subset(so, cells = colnames(so)[!so$label %in% small])
  }

  emb <- embed_lineage(so)
  so  <- emb$so
  so$start_score <- marker_score(so, cfg$start)
  so$end_score   <- marker_score(so, cfg$end)

  start_label <- if (!is.null(cfg$start_cluster)) cfg$start_cluster else
    names(which.max(tapply(so$start_score, so$label, mean, na.rm = TRUE)))

  traj_emb <- Embeddings(so, emb$red_traj)
  sce <- SingleCellExperiment(
    assays      = list(counts = get_layer(so, "counts")),
    colData     = S4Vectors::DataFrame(
      so@meta.data[, c("label", "group", "donor", "batch", "start_score", "end_score")]),
    reducedDims = list(TRAJ = traj_emb[, seq_len(min(n_dims_traj, ncol(traj_emb)))],
                       UMAP = Embeddings(so, emb$red_umap)[, 1:2])
  )

  imb <- imbalance_score(Object = reducedDim(sce, "UMAP"), conditions = sce$group,
                         k = 20, smooth = 40)
  sce$imbalance <- imb$scaled_scores

  sce <- slingshot(sce, clusterLabels = "label", reducedDim = "TRAJ",
                   start.clus = start_label, end.clus = cfg$end_cluster,
                   approx_points = 150)
  sds <- SlingshotDataSet(sce)
  pt  <- slingPseudotime(sds, na = FALSE)
  cw  <- slingCurveWeights(sds)
  lin_names <- paste0("Lineage", seq_len(ncol(pt)))
  colnames(pt) <- colnames(cw) <- lin_names
  sce$pt_avg <- rowSums(pt * cw) / pmax(rowSums(cw), 1e-8)
  paths <- setNames(vapply(slingLineages(sds), paste, character(1), collapse = " → "),
                    lin_names)

  sanity <- bind_rows(lapply(lin_names, function(l) {
    keep <- cw[, l] > 0.5
    data.frame(lineage   = l,
               n_cells   = sum(keep),
               rho_start = cor(pt[keep, l], sce$start_score[keep], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
               rho_end   = cor(pt[keep, l], sce$end_score[keep],   method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
  }))

  cell_df <- bind_rows(lapply(lin_names, function(l) {
    keep <- cw[, l] > 0.5
    data.frame(cell = colnames(sce)[keep], lineage = l, pt = pt[keep, l],
               label = sce$label[keep], donor = sce$donor[keep], group = sce$group[keep])
  }))

  list(name = lin_name, cfg = cfg, sce = sce, sds = sds, pt = pt, cw = cw,
       lin_names = lin_names, paths = paths, start_label = start_label,
       hvg = VariableFeatures(so), sanity = sanity, cell_df = cell_df,
       label_order = names(sort(tapply(sce$pt_avg, sce$label, median))),
       curves = curve_df(sce, "UMAP"))
}

plot_trajectory <- function(tr) {
  pal <- label_palette(tr$label_order)
  df  <- data.frame(reducedDim(tr$sce, "UMAP")) %>% setNames(c("x", "y")) %>%
    mutate(group = tr$sce$group, label = factor(tr$sce$label, levels = names(pal)),
           pt = tr$sce$pt_avg, imbalance = tr$sce$imbalance)
  add_curves <- function(p) {
    if (is.null(tr$curves)) return(p)
    p + geom_path(data = tr$curves, aes(x, y, group = lineage), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  linewidth = 0.9, colour = "black")
  }
  big <- guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))

  p1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = group)) + geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols) + big + theme_umap + labs(title = group_var)
  p2 <- add_curves(ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = label)) + geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) + big + theme_umap +
    labs(title = paste0("Fine labels (start: ", tr$start_label, ")"), colour = NULL))
  p3 <- add_curves(ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = pt)) + geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c() + theme_umap + labs(title = "Pseudotime", colour = NULL))
  p4 <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y, colour = imbalance)) + geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma") + theme_umap +
    labs(title = "Imbalance score", colour = NULL)
  (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)
}

plot_label_order <- function(tr) {
  df <- tr$cell_df %>% mutate(label = factor(label, levels = tr$label_order))
  ggplot(df, aes(pt, label, fill = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, width = 0.7, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols) +
    facet_wrap(~ lineage, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    labs(x = "Pseudotime", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
         title = "Fine labels along pseudotime (cells with lineage weight > 0.5)")
}
```

```{r show-trajectories, results='asis', fig.height=9}
for (i in seq_along(traj)) {
  tr <- traj[[i]]
  cat("\n\n### 7.5.", i, " ", tr$name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("Start label: **", tr$start_label, "**\n\n", sep = "")
```

## 7.6 Condition comparison: progression and fate

```{r condition-tests-fn}
condition_tests <- function(tr) {
  cond <- tr$sce$group

  topo <- if (run_topology)
    safe(topologyTest(tr$sds, conditions = cond, rep = topology_reps), "topologyTest") else NULL
  prog <- safe(progressionTest(tr$sds, conditions = cond, global = TRUE, lineages = TRUE),
               "progressionTest")
  fate <- if (length(tr$lin_names) > 1)
    safe(fateSelectionTest(tr$sds, conditions = cond, global = TRUE, pairwise = TRUE),
         "fateSelectionTest") else NULL

  donor_df <- tr$cell_df %>%
    group_by(lineage, donor, group) %>%
    summarise(median_pt = median(pt), n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_cells >= min_cells_donor)
  donor_prog <- donor_df %>% group_by(lineage) %>%
    group_modify(~ donor_test(.x, "median_pt")) %>% ungroup()

  fate_df <- donor_fate <- NULL
  if (length(tr$lin_names) > 1) {
    fate_df <- data.frame(donor = tr$sce$donor, group = tr$sce$group,
                          lineage = tr$lin_names[max.col(tr$cw, ties.method = "first")]) %>%
      count(donor, group, lineage) %>%
      group_by(donor) %>% filter(sum(n) >= min_cells_donor) %>%
      mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
      complete(nesting(donor, group), lineage, fill = list(n = 0, frac = 0))
    donor_fate <- fate_df %>% group_by(lineage) %>%
      group_modify(~ donor_test(.x, "frac")) %>% ungroup()
  }

  list(topology = topo, progression = prog, fate = fate,
       donor_df = donor_df, donor_progression = donor_prog,
       donor_usage = fate_df, donor_fate = donor_fate)
}

plot_progression <- function(tr, ct) {
  p1 <- ggplot(tr$cell_df, aes(pt, fill = group)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.45, colour = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols) +
    facet_wrap(~ lineage, scales = "free") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    labs(x = "Pseudotime", fill = NULL, title = "Cell density along pseudotime (cell level)")
  p2 <- ggplot(tr$cell_df %>% filter(donor %in% ct$donor_df$donor),
               aes(pt, group = donor, colour = group)) +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) + scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols) +
    facet_wrap(~ lineage, scales = "free_x") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    labs(x = "Pseudotime", y = "ECDF", colour = NULL, title = "Per-donor progression")
  p3 <- ggplot(ct$donor_df, aes(group, median_pt, colour = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, seed = 1), size = 2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols) + facet_wrap(~ lineage, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) + theme(legend.position = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Median pseudotime per donor", title = "Donor-level progression")
  p1 / p2 / p3
}
```

```{r condition-tests}
ctests <- list()
for (nm in names(traj)) {
  ctests[[nm]] <- safe(cached(file.path(path$cache_pseudotime, paste0(nm, "_condition_tests.rds")),
                              condition_tests(traj[[nm]])),
                       paste(nm, "condition tests"))
  ct <- ctests[[nm]]
  if (is.null(ct)) next
  d <- lin_dir(nm)
  if (!is.null(ct$topology))    write.csv(ct$topology,    file.path(d, "condiments_topology.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(ct$progression)) write.csv(ct$progression, file.path(d, "condiments_progression.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(ct$fate))        write.csv(ct$fate,        file.path(d, "condiments_fate.csv"),        row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(ct$donor_df,          file.path(d, "donor_median_pseudotime.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(ct$donor_progression, file.path(d, "donor_progression_test.csv"),  row.names = FALSE)
  if (!is.null(ct$donor_fate)) {
    write.csv(ct$donor_usage, file.path(d, "donor_lineage_usage.csv"),      row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(ct$donor_fate,  file.path(d, "donor_lineage_usage_test.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r show-condition-tests, results='asis', fig.height=11}
for (i in seq_along(traj)) {
  nm <- names(traj)[i]; tr <- traj[[nm]]; ct <- ctests[[nm]]
  if (is.null(ct)) next
  cat("\n\n### 7.6.", i, " ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  show_table(ct$topology, "Topology test (condiments) – significant = conditions may need separate trajectories")
  show_table(ct$progression, "Progression test (condiments, cell level)")
  show_table(ct$donor_progression, "Progression, donor level (median pseudotime per donor)")
  if (!is.null(ct$fate)) {
    show_table(ct$fate, "Fate selection test (condiments, cell level)")
    show_table(ct$donor_fate, "Lineage usage, donor level")
  }
  print(plot_progression(tr, ct))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## 7.7 Gene dynamics along pseudotime (tradeSeq)

```{r tradeseq-fn}
fit_tradeseq <- function(tr) {
  counts_mat <- counts(tr$sce)
  cond       <- tr$sce$group
  goi        <- intersect(tr$cfg$goi, rownames(counts_mat))
  genes_use  <- unique(c(head(tr$hvg, n_gam_genes), goi))
  genes_use  <- genes_use[Matrix::rowSums(counts_mat[genes_use, , drop = FALSE] > 0) >= 10]
  bp <- MulticoreParam(workers = n_cores)

  if (run_evaluateK) {
    pdf(file.path(lin_dir(tr$name), "tradeSeq_evaluateK.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)
    safe(evaluateK(counts = counts_mat[genes_use, ], sds = tr$sds, conditions = cond,
                   k = 3:8, nGenes = 200, verbose = FALSE), "evaluateK")
    dev.off()
  }

  message(tr$name, ": fitting GAMs for ", length(genes_use), " genes")
  gam <- fitGAM(counts = counts_mat, sds = tr$sds, conditions = cond,
                genes = match(genes_use, rownames(counts_mat)),
                nknots = nknots, parallel = TRUE, BPPARAM = bp, verbose = FALSE)

  tidy_test <- function(res) res %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(pvalue)) %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, "fdr")) %>%
    arrange(desc(waldStat))

  list(gam = gam,
       cond_res  = tidy_test(conditionTest(gam, global = TRUE, lineages = TRUE)),
       assoc_res = tidy_test(associationTest(gam, global = TRUE, lineages = TRUE)))
}

plot_smoothers <- function(tr, ts, n_top = 4) {
  genes <- unique(c(intersect(tr$cfg$goi, rownames(ts$gam)),
                    head(ts$cond_res$gene[ts$cond_res$padj < 0.05], n_top)))
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(NULL)
  counts_mat <- counts(tr$sce)
  wrap_plots(lapply(genes, function(g)
    plotSmoothers(ts$gam, counts_mat, gene = g, alpha = 0.3, sample = 0.5) +
      ggtitle(g) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 6))),
    ncol = 3)
}

plot_heatmap <- function(ts, n = 30) {
  top <- head(ts$cond_res$gene[ts$cond_res$padj < 0.05], n)
  if (length(top) < 2) return(NULL)
  ps <- predictSmooth(ts$gam, gene = top, nPoints = 50, tidy = TRUE)
  if (!"condition" %in% names(ps)) ps$condition <- "all"
  hm <- ps %>%
    mutate(yhat = log1p(yhat)) %>%
    group_by(gene) %>% mutate(z = as.numeric(scale(yhat))) %>%
    group_by(gene, lineage, condition) %>% arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(pos = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
  gene_order <- hm %>% group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(peak = pos[which.max(z)], .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(peak) %>% pull(gene)
  ggplot(hm, aes(pos, factor(gene, levels = rev(gene_order)), fill = z)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B") +
    facet_grid(. ~ lineage + condition, labeller = label_both) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    labs(x = "Pseudotime \u2192", y = NULL, fill = "z",
         title = "Top condition-dependent genes (tradeSeq conditionTest, cell level)")
}
```

## 7.8 Donor-aware pseudobulk along pseudotime

```{r pseudobulk-fn}
pseudobulk_bins <- function(tr) {
  counts_mat <- counts(tr$sce)
  out <- lapply(tr$lin_names, function(l) safe({
    d <- tr$cell_df %>% filter(lineage == l)
    brks  <- unique(quantile(d$pt, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)))
    d$bin <- cut(d$pt, brks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
    d$grp <- make.names(as.character(d$group))
    d$sample <- paste(d$donor, d$bin, sep = "__")

    pb   <- pseudobulk(counts_mat[, d$cell], d$sample)
    meta <- d %>% group_by(sample, donor, grp, bin) %>%
      summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")
    meta <- meta[match(colnames(pb), meta$sample), ]
    keep <- meta$n_cells >= min_cells_pb
    pb <- pb[, keep, drop = FALSE]; meta <- meta[keep, ]
    meta$gb <- factor(paste0(meta$grp, "_b", meta$bin))

    y_all  <- DGEList(pb)
    logcpm <- cpm(y_all, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
    y <- calcNormFactors(y_all[filterByExpr(y_all, group = meta$gb), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE])

    design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + gb, data = meta)
    colnames(design) <- levels(meta$gb)
    v   <- voom(y, design)
    dc  <- duplicateCorrelation(v, design, block = meta$donor)
    v   <- voom(y, design, block = meta$donor, correlation = dc$consensus.correlation)
    dc  <- duplicateCorrelation(v, design, block = meta$donor)
    fit <- lmFit(v, design, block = meta$donor, correlation = dc$consensus.correlation)

    ref  <- make.names(ref_level)
    cons <- character(0)
    for (g in setdiff(unique(meta$grp), ref)) for (b in sort(unique(meta$bin))) {
      a <- paste0(g, "_b", b); r <- paste0(ref, "_b", b)
      if (sum(meta$gb == a) >= 2 && sum(meta$gb == r) >= 2)
        cons[paste0(g, "_vs_", ref, "_bin", b)] <- paste0(a, " - ", r)
    }
    if (length(cons) == 0) stop("no bin with >= 2 donors per group")
    cm <- makeContrasts(contrasts = unname(cons), levels = design)
    colnames(cm) <- names(cons)
    fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, cm))

    per_bin <- bind_rows(lapply(colnames(cm), function(k)
      topTable(fit2, coef = k, number = Inf) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>% mutate(contrast = k)))
    any_bin <- topTable(fit2, number = Inf) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")

    g_plot <- intersect(tr$cfg$goi, rownames(logcpm))
    goi_df <- as.data.frame(t(logcpm[g_plot, , drop = FALSE])) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      left_join(meta, by = "sample") %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(g_plot), names_to = "gene", values_to = "logCPM")

    list(per_bin = per_bin, any_bin = any_bin, meta = meta, goi_df = goi_df,
         consensus_cor = dc$consensus.correlation,
         n_sig = per_bin %>% group_by(contrast) %>%
           summarise(up = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC > 0),
                     down = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC < 0), .groups = "drop"))
  }, paste(tr$name, l, "pseudobulk")))
  setNames(out, tr$lin_names)
}

plot_donor_genes <- function(pb, title) {
  if (is.null(pb) || nrow(pb$goi_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  ggplot(pb$goi_df, aes(bin, logCPM, colour = grp)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = donor), alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = grp), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols_clean) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    labs(x = "Pseudotime bin", colour = NULL, title = title)
}
```

```{r pseudobulk}
pb_res <- list()
for (nm in names(traj)) {
  pb_res[[nm]] <- pseudobulk_bins(traj[[nm]])
  for (l in names(pb_res[[nm]])) {
    pb <- pb_res[[nm]][[l]]
    if (is.null(pb)) next
    write.csv(pb$per_bin, file.path(lin_dir(nm), paste0("pseudobulk_", l, "_per_bin.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(pb$any_bin, file.path(lin_dir(nm), paste0("pseudobulk_", l, "_any_bin.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(pb$meta,    file.path(lin_dir(nm), paste0("pseudobulk_", l, "_samples.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r show-pseudobulk, results='asis', fig.height=6}
for (i in seq_along(pb_res)) {
  nm <- names(pb_res)[i]
  cat("\n\n### 7.8.", i, " ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  for (l in names(pb_res[[nm]])) {
    pb <- pb_res[[nm]][[l]]
    if (is.null(pb)) next
    cat("**", l, "** (", traj[[nm]]$paths[[l]], ") – donor correlation across bins: ",
        round(pb$consensus_cor, 2), "\n\n", sep = "")
    show_table(pb$n_sig, "Genes differing per bin (limma, FDR < 0.05)")
    show_table(pb$any_bin %>% select(gene, F, P.Value, adj.P.Val), "Top genes, any bin", n = 10)
    p <- plot_donor_genes(pb, paste(nm, l, "– donor pseudobulk along pseudotime"))
    if (!is.null(p)) { print(p); cat("\n\n") }
  }
}
```

## 7.9 Summary

```{r summary}
summary_prog <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ctests), function(nm) {
  ct <- ctests[[nm]]
  if (is.null(ct)) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(
    if (!is.null(ct$progression))
      ct$progression %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character), level = "cell (condiments)"),
    ct$donor_progression %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character), level = "donor")
  ) %>% mutate(trajectory = nm)
}))
write.csv(summary_prog, file.path(path$results_pseudotime, "summary_progression.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

summary_genes <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ts_res), function(nm) {
  if (is.null(ts_res[[nm]])) return(NULL)
  ts_res[[nm]]$cond_res %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    select(gene, waldStat, pvalue, padj) %>% mutate(trajectory = nm)
}))
write.csv(summary_genes, file.path(path$results_pseudotime, "summary_tradeSeq_condition_genes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

summary_pb <- bind_rows(lapply(names(pb_res), function(nm)
  bind_rows(lapply(names(pb_res[[nm]]), function(l)
    if (!is.null(pb_res[[nm]][[l]]))
      pb_res[[nm]][[l]]$n_sig %>% mutate(trajectory = nm, lineage = l)))))
write.csv(summary_pb, file.path(path$results_pseudotime, "summary_pseudobulk_bins.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

knitr::kable(summary_prog, caption = "Progression: cell vs donor level")
knitr::kable(summary_genes %>% count(trajectory, name = "tradeSeq genes FDR < 0.05"))
knitr::kable(summary_pb, caption = "Pseudobulk: genes per bin (FDR < 0.05)")
```
